detail.longDescription: Meta has shifted to a new family of flagship AI models called Muse and sent the Llama "herd" of models to the farm upstate. It's a dramatic but understandable shift in AI strategy from the company that was once pioneering open models. The newest models are Muse Wonder and Muse Spark, and they're Meta's first real attempt at top-tier frontier models. Unlike the Llama models, both are closed-weight proprietary models. You won't be able to download them from Hugging Face or run them on your own mac
